name: XLZD
summary: XLZD combines experience from XENON, LZ and DARWIN to plan a next-generation large liquid-xenon observatory, targeting WIMPs in the neutrino-background regime and a range of rare-event measurements.
detection_principle: A dual-phase liquid-xenon target of several tens of tonnes uses light, ionization and position to identify rare interactions, requiring extremely clean materials and control of radon and krypton backgrounds.

status.label: In planning
status.evidence: The 2025 design report and collaboration website describe a next-generation observatory under development.

timeline.event: Predecessor teams sign a memorandum of understanding

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
